summary.caption: Flat, evenly lit archival scan of a page printed and filled in by hand from the archive, dated 1700. The cream paper carries 5 lines of cursive handwriting in brown ink and 6 printed lines in black printer's ink. A heading sits at the top center. Five straight ruled lines cross the page:.
